title: Conditional Reversal of Test-Time Updates Does Not Outperform Rate-Matched Random Reversal: A Pre-Registered Study (code and data)
description: Code and data accompanying the article "Conditional Reversal of Test-Time Updates Does Not Outperform Rate-Matched Random Reversal: A Pre-Registered Study" (JoVE submission JoVE75807, revision). Code under code/ is licensed MIT; data under data/ are licensed CC BY 4.0. The files in data/superseded/ are INVALID logs from the uncorrected first run of the random-revert control and are retained for audit only (see data/superseded/DO_NOT_USE.md). The pre-registration document referred to in the article could not be recovered and is not included.
